title: Assembly: Hello World
description: Write an assembly program (using NASM syntax simulation) that prints 'Hello, Assembly!'.

codeTemplate.asm:
; Simulated assembly
section .data
    msg db 'Hello, Assembly!', 0

section .text
    global _start
_start:
    ; Print message
    mov eax, 4
    mov ebx, 1
    mov ecx, msg
    int 0x80
    ; Exit
    mov eax, 1
    xor ebx, ebx
    int 0x80

hints: NASM syntax: `section .data` for data, `section .text` for code
